newsitem.title: USA: Ind.treasurer gives $100 bonuses to 12 staffers.
newsitem.headline: Ind.treasurer gives $100 bonuses to 12 staffers.

text.p: Indiana Treasurer Joyce Brinkman on Monday gave each of her 12 permanent full-time staff members a $100 bonus out of her own pocket.
"It came out of my pocket, that is why (the bonuses) weren't more," Brinkman said. "Unfortunately for the staff, I am not a wealthy person."
Brinkman said the office processed a record $18.88 billion and generated more than $242 million interest in fiscal 1997 while operating on a budget of less than $1 million.
The treasurer also returned more than 18 percent of the funds budgeted for office operations to the state general fund last year, Brinkman said.
